current_academic_crosscheck.source: Gramota.ru — academic rule: isolated nonagreed definitions
Gramota.ru — academic rule: isolated circumstances / gerunds

current_branches: nonagreed definition with a proper name: normally isolated because the referent is already individualized
with a common noun: isolation depends on whether the phrase is additional/explanatory versus necessary identifying content
comparative-degree definition with dependents: context and explanatory function matter
infinitive definition: dash when it adds an explanatory 'namely' meaning, especially after an already modified noun; internal-position cases require separate structural analysis
decisions.patch_policy: Existing structured unit is correct. Keep position, referent type and explanatory/restrictive function as independent diagnostics; never reduce to a five-item ALWAYS list.

current_branches: по имени / по фамилии / по прозвищу / по происхождению / родом: isolated when explanatory, may be non-isolated when carrying the main identifying meaning
ИЛИ: isolated only in explanatory meaning = то есть; ordinary disjunction is different
ТО ЕСТЬ: introduces an explanatory construction; it is not itself an introductory word
например / в том числе / особенно / даже: punctuation follows the joining/explanatory construction, not the surface word alone
decisions.patch_policy: Keep one structured apposition/explanation unit because the learner decision is connector function + construction scope, not memorization of automatic comma-trigger words.

decisions.current_rule: Gerund forms inside phraseologized integral expressions are not isolated under the ordinary gerund rule.
decisions.patch_policy: Keep the source list as provenance, but promote rare members to learner-facing practice only after dictionary/phraseology confirmation; no phrase becomes an 'idiom' merely because the old textbook listed it.

current_model: non-isolation is possible when the single gerund/form directly characterizes manner of the predicate action and is functionally close to an adverb
the same form may be isolated when position, spread, intonation or context restores a distinct secondary-action meaning
forms in -а/-я are statistically more prone to manner meaning, but suffix shape is not an automatic punctuation algorithm
decisions.verified_contrast: не спеша бегут / спросил, не останавливаясь; улыбаясь in different positions can change isolation
decisions.patch_policy: Do not classify by a fixed word list; require sentence-level syntactic function.

current_model: after an ordinary conjunction/conjunctive word the gerund phrase is normally separated because the conjunction is outside the phrase
with А, comma after А is used when the gerund phrase can be removed/rearranged without breaking the structure
no comma between А and the gerund phrase when А is structurally/semantically integrated and omission forces sentence rebuilding
a conjunction that itself begins/enters the gerund construction is a separate case and is not split mechanically
decisions.patch_policy: Existing detachability test is current and precise; no count change.
